The '''Ancient Pyramid''', also known as the '''Jaldraocht Pyramid''', meaning Tomb of Magic in an old desert language,{{CitePostbag|issue=25|letter=Letter 2|author=High Priest (Sophanem)|quote=The more antique pyramids were named long ago, when the people of the desert spoke a very different language. 'Jal' simply means 'tomb' in this tongue – so it is that we have the 'Tomb of Kings', the 'Tomb of the Agile' and the 'Tomb of Magic'.}} is located south of the [[Bandit Camp (Kharidian Desert)|Bandit Camp]] in the [[Kharidian Desert]].

It is a key location in the [[quest]] [[Desert Treasure I]], and upon its completion, can be used by players to switch their [[spellbook]] to [[Ancient Magicks]] or back, as well as create [[magic tablet]]s for Ancient Magicks teleports via the nearby lectern. During the quest, players must use the main entrance of the pyramid to get in, which requires them to run past attacking creatures (see below) while dodging traps. The pyramid has four levels, each of which is larger in width than the last. Some players consider getting through to be of some difficulty, as the traps will send the player back to the entrance. After the completion of the quest, players may use the south entrance to return to the centre of the pyramid without frustration.

After completion of the Desert Treasure I quest, players can buy the [[ancient staff]] from [[Eblis]] for 80,000 [[coins]]. If they happen to lose it, they can buy one from another player or kill [[mummies]] inside the pyramid for another.

Various [[Sarcophagus (Ancient Pyramid)|sarcophagi]] can be found within the pyramid, and can be looted, yielding small treasure such as [[gems]], [[gold bar]]s, and [[sapphire ring]]s.

==Transportation==
Various methods exist for reaching the Ancient Pyramid:

* The fastest way to reach the pyramid is to use the Jaldraocht teleport of the [[Pharaoh's sceptre]]. 
* The second fastest way is by using a [[Camulet]] and teleporting to [[Enahkra's temple]] just north-west of the pyramid, following the completion of the hard [[Desert Diary]]. Without the hard Desert Diary completed the teleport will be inside the temple, and you will have to navigate out.
* Teleport to the [[Portal (Player-owned house)|POH portal]] in [[Pollnivneach]] using a [[Pollnivneach teleport]] tablet (or [[Teleport to House]] for players who have their [[player-owned house|houses]] located in Pollnivneach) and run south, through Pollnivneach, around the cliffs then west to the pyramid. This is the third fastest way.
* Use a [[Nardah teleport]] scroll and run west across the bridge to the pyramid.
* Use the [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|BIQ}} (Kalphite Hive) and run south-west around cliffs, then south-east to the Pyramid.
* From [[Al Kharid]] (you can teleport there using charged [[amulet of glory]], [[ring of dueling]] or the [[Minigame Teleport]] for [[Giant's Foundry]], or you can fly a [[Gnome glider]]) take the ferry via [[Ferryman Sathwood]] to the [[Ruins of Unkah]]. Enter the desert (you will need a [[Shantay pass (item)|Shantay pass]] to go into the desert; you can buy one from [[Shantay Guard (Ruins of Unkah)|the guard there]] for 5 coins), then run north to the pyramid.

==History==
{{References needed}}
During the [[God Wars]], many enormous battles were fought within the [[Kharidian Desert]]. [[Azzanadra]], a powerful [[Zarosian]] [[Mahjarrat]], was an active warrior who fought in the desert to protect the Zarosian groups who fled into the desert when Zaros fell. Azzanadra was incredibly powerful, and wiped out enormous armies on his own.

Because Azzanadra was nearly invincible, he was a great danger to the armies of [[Saradomin]] and [[Zamorak]], and so a group of Zamorakians decided to bring him down. They cast a spell upon him which bound Azzanadra's power into [[Diamonds of Azzanadra|four diamonds]]. The Pyramid may have been built to imprison Azzanadra, although its architecture and the fact that it contains ancient Zarosian warrior mages buried in its catacombs indicates that it is likely a much older structure built some time during the Second Age by followers of Zaros.

During Desert Treasure I, the player found the four diamonds and used it to release Azzanadra from the pyramid.

==Map==
[[File:Ancient Pyramid inside.png|thumb|The mummy-infested corridors of the pyramid.]]
:''The levels in the pyramid are numbered in the order the player encounters them in the Desert Treasure I quest.''

The exterior of the pyramid is not dangerous, other than the effects of [[desert heat]]. Heat is not a factor inside the pyramid, but almost all of the interior is dangerous, with level 103 [[Mummies]] roaming about, level 92 [[Scarabs]] occasionally boiling out of the floor, and level 96 mummies sometimes spontaneously popping out of [[Sarcophagus (Ancient Pyramid)|sarcophagi]]. Also, on Levels 1-3, random traps in the floor occasionally open up underneath the player, depositing the player outside, next to the south side of the pyramid. (The scarab swarms, spontaneous mummies, and traps cannot be detected in advance.) The room containing the altar on Level 4, however, has no traps but swarms and mummies can still appear.

Higher levels in [[Agility]] and [[Thieving]] will give the player a better chance at avoiding some of the traps inside of the Ancient Pyramid.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1249796079828303875|date=13 April 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/103824|archivedate=19 April 2023|quote=Just Agility level. Underground Pass never checks your weight or energy. Desert Treasure checks Agility and Thieving.}}{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1256923805857046531|date=3 May 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106909|archivedate=14 April 2023|quote=If you're referring to the pyramid traps, those are checking both Agility and Thieving.}} Weight-reducing items may also be of use while running through the long corridors of the pyramid. The traps do not stop your forward motion, so opening one's house options will prevent most if not all traps from triggering. Being attacked closes the options, so be sure to reopen them afterwards.

===Outside===
[[File:Ancient Pyramid outside.png|thumb|200px]]
During the [[Desert Treasure I]] quest, the player must enter the pyramid from its top. The outside entrance to Level 4 and the [[Ancient Magicks]] altar can only be used after the quest.{{clear}}

===Level 1===
[[File:Ancient Pyramid level 1.png|thumb|200px]]
This level is the smallest in area, with the fewest [[mummies]] roaming about. The purple line on the map marks the route from the entrance ladder to the ladder to the next level.{{clear}}

===Level 2===
[[File:Ancient Pyramid level 2.png|thumb|200px]]
This level is the second smallest in area, with a few more mummies roaming about. The purple line on the map marks the route from the entrance ladder to the ladder to the next level.{{clear}}

===Level 3===
[[File:Ancient Pyramid level 3.png|thumb|200px]]
This level is fairly large in area, presenting more of a challenge to players traversing it. A significant number of mummies are roaming about. The purple line on the map marks the route from the entrance ladder to the ladder to the next level.{{clear}}

===Level 4===
[[File:Ancient Pyramid level 4.png|thumb|200px]]
This level is quite large in area, with many mummies roaming everywhere but the altar room. The purple line on the map marks the route from the entrance ladder to the altar room. In the Desert Treasure I quest, [[Azzanadra]] is in the altar room. The altar allows players to switch their [[spellbook]] between [[Ancient Magicks]] and the [[Standard spellbook]]. It does not, however, recharge [[Prayer points]] - instead draining them to allow the switch to the Ancient Magicks spellbook. On the east side of the portal room there is an [[Lectern (Ancient)|Ancient Lectern]] allowing players to create [[Magic_tablet|tablets]] of teleportation spells from the Ancient Magicks spellbook. A portal next to altar lets the player exit the room directly, depositing them outside the pyramid.

After the quest, Azzanadra is not in the altar room, and the room can be accessed directly from the entrance on the south side of the pyramid.

==Inhabitants==
*[[Mummy|Mummies]]
*[[Scarabs]]

==Trivia==
* The word "draíocht", from Jaldraocht, translates to "magic" in Irish. "Jal" means tomb, so the name of the pyramid translates to Tomb of Magic.
